people_basis: all residents of the neighbourhood (street trees shade people who live in or walk through it; no catchment radius exists at neighbourhood level)
evidence_status: Surface and street-air cooling measured in Athens (City thermal camera; Tsiros 2010); neighbourhood-mean air effect small (Iungman 2023, Ziter 2019); no health outcome claimed
data_gaps: tree-pit register or list of plantable spots (capacity_unverified);survival of Athens plantings (no survival record);whether the canopy model of ~2018-2020 misses trees planted since
rule_text: Eligible where the canopy deficit to the target is positive. Quantity = trees needed for +1 percentage point of canopy (capped at the deficit), from crown area and survival. Capacity = trees needed to close the whole deficit.

name_en: Cool or green roof on municipal buildings
quantity_unit: m2 of matched roof footprint (lower bound)
people_basis: occupants of the matched buildings: unknown (no pupils/staff count in open data), so empty
evidence_status: moderate (catalogue H10): simulation calibrated on measurements, one Athens nursery school; effect is inside the building
data_gaps: roof price per m2 is an assumption (low from the City of Athens 2012 price list, central and high from vendor figures), a City quote is needed;share of the matched roof that is flat and usable;occupants and energy use of the buildings;municipal buildings missing from the matched layers (libraries; sports halls; markets)
rule_text: Eligible where matched school roof + other municipal building roof is positive. Quantity = that area (lower bound: one building per point; flat/usable share unknown).

name_en: Cool surface in schoolyards and playgrounds
quantity_unit: sites (schools and playgrounds with canopy <5% within 150 m)
people_basis: children 0-14 living in the neighbourhood (upper proxy; pupils per school and playground users are not available)
evidence_status: moderate (catalogue H8): surface temperature measured at Flisvos; air effect only simulated; cost from a single source
data_gaps: yard or playground area per site (no dataset has it);second source for the price per m2
rule_text: Eligible where at least one school or playground has canopy <5% within 150 m. Quantity = number of such sites. Cost only if a yard-area parameter exists.

people_basis: children 0-14 living in the neighbourhood (upper proxy; pupils per school are not available)
evidence_status: moderate (catalogue A3): GLA 2021 study of 18 London schools; NO2 at the gate only
data_gaps: pupils per school;which streets can legally and practically be closed (traffic decision and enforcement);an Athens price per scheme
rule_text: Eligible where the neighbourhood has at least one school. Quantity = number of schools (upper bound: assumes every school has a closable street).

name_en: Heat support for elderly (phone/home visits; elderly clubs as cool points)
quantity_unit: residents 65+ (upper bound of people who could be covered)
evidence_status: moderate (catalogue H5): Rome, ecological and non-randomised, isolated 80+; cost not reported
data_gaps: cost of the programme per person;number of isolated residents 80+ (the Rome target group; the 80+ file column is a model share and is not used);municipal heat-death baseline (assumption)
rule_text: Eligible where residents 65+ is positive and the canopy deficit to the target is positive (heat-exposure gap). Quantity = residents 65+ (ceiling); elderly clubs are reported as venues.
